title: Account Suspended for Policy Violation - Customer Disputes Suspension
agent_context: Customer’s account was suspended for a policy violation and they are disputing the action. Provide a high-level explanation without disclosing sensitive triggers, guide the appeal process, and set a realistic review timeline with update cadence.

raw_content.initial_message: Our account was suspended overnight with no warning. My entire team is locked out and we have active client work running today. We reviewed our usage and we don’t see any policy violation. I need a clear explanation of what triggered this and I need access restored immediately.
raw_content.context: Account suspended for policy violation (internal risk/compliance action). Policy: take concern seriously; do not disclose sensitive enforcement signals; do not promise reinstatement; provide high-level explanation; guide appeal/review process; collect necessary identifiers; escalate to compliance team; set realistic review timeline and update cadence.

learning_objectives: Set realistic timelines and update cadence
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge severity and apologize for disruption
Confirm account identifiers and verify requester identity/role as needed
Explain at a high level: suspension triggered by policy review; you may not be able to share specific signals
Offer appeal/review path: what information they need to provide and what happens next
Escalate case to compliance/risk team with priority due to business impact
Set expectations: review timeline and next update time (cadence)
Offer immediate safe options if available (export invoices, provide status updates, connect to account manager)
common_mistakes: Sharing internal detection details or sensitive enforcement reasons
Not providing a clear appeal path

bonus_points: Offers to involve account manager for business coordination
Provides a concise checklist of what the customer should send for review
sticky_notes: KEY: Stay neutral. ‘We’ll review’ is safer than implying guilt or innocence.
TRAP: Do not disclose sensitive enforcement triggers or internal system names.
HINT: Make the appeal steps concrete and time-bound.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Customer calms down if you explain boundaries clearly, provide a concrete appeal checklist, and commit to a specific next update time
